svg.text: tallest ears or hat about 1.77 m
16-bone rig (Hips, Spine, Neck, Head, 3 per arm, 3 per leg)
ears: tri, round, long, tufts, antennae
front: scarf, collar, ruff, held item
tail: rides on Hips, no bones
colour + pattern: skin, belly, hands, feet
Shared base: one body, one skeleton, one animation set
Every concept is this body plus swappable parts. In game the bare base stands 1.35 m (band 1.3–1.4 m), so doors, 0.75 m tables, tools and camera still fit.
